backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two NavBar fixes: rendering the 'Get In Touch' nav link using the translations system, and ensuring the mobile hamburger menu dropdown always has a solid white background.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Truncated JSON file containing one- to two-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and key changes.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including color tokens for background, foreground, borders, charts, and sidebar.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module for the True Origin Company LLP site.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app shell that sets up TanStack Router routes, the NavBar with scroll-aware styling, mobile hamburger menu with solid white dropdown background, and desktop/mobile nav links using the centralized translations system including the `nav.getInTouch` key.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component that uses the `useLanguage` hook to render all text content—headings, body copy, checklist items, operations list, and vision/mission cards—in the selected language.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with an info panel showing address, phone, and two mailto email links, plus an enquiry form with submission state, all text sourced from the centralized translations system.
frontend/src/components/ExportCargoSecti: Renders a logistics/export cargo section with a hero image, three highlight cards (compliance, packaging, global reach), and i18n support via useLanguage.
frontend/src/components/ExportCertificat: Full-page component displaying export certifications (APEDA, FSSAI, etc.), quality control steps, and detailed product specifications with packaging and documentation info for Moringa products.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with brand logo, contact details, quick navigation links that support smooth-scrolling from any route, and a copyright line with dynamic year.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, overlay, headline/subheadline, CTA buttons linking to the export certification page and contact section, and a scroll-down indicator.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown component for switching between English, Hindi, and Marathi using the LanguageContext, with styling that adapts based on whether the navbar is scrolled.
frontend/src/components/PrivacyPolicyPag: Static privacy policy page that renders translated sections from i18n keys, an intro block, and a contact callout, scrolling to the top on mount.
Renders a products showcase section with a 4-column grid of product cards (moringa, curry leaves, vegetables, custom sourcing) and a row of farm images, using i18n translations and TanStack Router links.
frontend/src/components/QualityComplianc: Displays a quality and compliance section on a deep emerald background, listing six documentation/certification items with shield icons and a CTA button that scrolls to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/SocialMediaSecti: Renders a social media section with three placeholder video cards marked 'coming soon' and Instagram/YouTube icon links, using i18n translations.
frontend/src/components/TermsAndConditio: A standalone Terms and Conditions page that renders eight translated sections, an intro block, and a contact callout with email links, scrolling to top on mount.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a React context for language selection (en/hi/mr) with a translation lookup function `t` that falls back to English or the raw key.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/clear functions and status flags for use throughout the app.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Playfair Display and Poppins fonts, defines CSS custom properties for the design system (light and dark themes), and sets base Tailwind directives.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/translations/translations.t: Defines a `Language` type and a `translations` object containing English, Hindi, and Marathi string keys for all UI sections (navigation, hero, about, products, quality, contact, etc.) used for multi-language support across the site.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom color palettes (deepEmerald, softGold, cream, forest, gold), typography fonts (Playfair Display, Poppins), custom shadows, border radii, accordion animations, and plugins for animate, typography, and container queries.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state (version 29) for the TrueOrigin Exports website, documenting the site summary, architectural decisions, known UI bugs, and a list of existing and planned features.
